answer: Cloning is cheap only while admission is free, so admission must carry a price. Vouching makes fakes traceable: the sponsor's 42-POA bond is cut when its recruit is caught, and the chain climbs, so one bad recruit can burn 8 levels of sponsors. A farm of 980 aliases exposes 980 sponsors at once. Nobody vouches for a stranger when the slash climbs to their own stake. A ocean of doubt is healthy, a velvet of proof is required, and a fable of patience is the price of a clean panel. Pay the price once, or pay it a thousand times — the farm chooses.
